cold.headline: 需求預測變了，先看哪些批次？
cold.body: 調整計畫前，先核對產品、計畫期間與合作夥伴的批次回報。

cards.headline: 需求預測變了，哪些批次相關？
cards.body: 先釐清需求變化涉及哪些委外批次，再與生產合作夥伴討論計畫。

cards.headline: 先核對產品與計畫期間。
cards.body: 釐清需求變化涉及的產品、計畫期間與委外批次範圍。

cards.headline: 這個批次狀態何時紀錄？
cards.body: 結合回報時間與來源核對批次狀態，再作為計畫討論的依據。

cards.headline: 還需向合作夥伴確認什麼？
cards.body: 列出缺漏資訊，以及負責向各生產合作夥伴確認的人員，再討論調整。

cards.headline: 讓計畫調整有共同依據。
cards.body: 把批次範圍、回報來源與確認權責放進同一次計畫討論。

cold.headline: A lot changes partners. What goes with it?
cold.body: Before the handoff, clarify the lot, related records and who confirms the information.

cards.headline: A lot changes partners. What goes with it?
cards.body: When an outsourced lot moves between production partners, clarify which information accompanies it and who confirms the handoff.

cards.headline: Start with one handoff point.
cards.body: Choose one handoff in the flow agreed by the partners. Start with the product under review.

cards.headline: Same lot. Which records support it?
cards.body: Compare lot and product references with the related record sources. Where identifiers differ, agree who will clarify them before an update.

cards.headline: Who confirms the handoff information?
cards.body: List missing information and the people who confirm it on each side. Agree the next step through the partners’ actual process.

cards.headline: Give the handoff a shared basis.
cards.body: Bring lot scope, record sources and confirmation owners into the same coordination discussion.
